claims.claim: STLD's Q2 2026 fabrication backlog was nearly 45% above the prior year and extended into Q1 2027, but Q2 fabrication operating income was $85 million versus $90 million in Q1 because higher steel raw-material input costs offset increased shipments and steady pricing; backlog volume therefore does not establish backlog margin quality.

Aluminum ramp risk is observable rather than hypothetical: Q1 2026 aluminum operating losses were $65 million after normal startup issues caused a temporary operating pause and inventory write-off; Q2 losses improved to $33 million while customer qualifications remained underway, so the improvement path is higher utilization/yields, lower startup costs and completed qualifications rather than assuming the ramp is already de-risked.

Liquidity and cash generation provide resilience against these execution risks: STLD reported $2.0 billion of liquidity at June 30, 2026 and $428 million of Q2 operating cash flow, while continuing capital investment and repurchases.

causalEdges.mechanism: input inflation offset increased shipments and steady pricing in Q2 2026
causalEdges.falsifier: future disclosures show sustained fabrication margin expansion despite comparable input-cost pressure

causalEdges.mechanism: startup interruptions, utilization, yields and customer qualification determine conversion of installed capacity into profitable shipments
causalEdges.falsifier: sustained positive aluminum operating income with completed qualifications and stable utilization

risks.risk: Backlog quantity can overstate economic quality if contract pricing/pass-through does not absorb steel input inflation.
Aluminum diversification remains exposed to commissioning, yield, utilization and customer-qualification execution until profitability is demonstrated.

contradictions.claim: Strong backlog/demand coexists with weaker fabrication economics under higher steel input costs.
contradictions.resolution: These observations are compatible: demand volume can rise while contract-level margin compresses. Treat backlog size and backlog economics as separate variables.

unknowns.unknown: Whether aluminum reaches durable positive operating income on the company's expected ramp path remains unverified by the cited Q1/Q2 releases.
